scope: local CPU and elapsed time for legacy cross-check only

method.baseline: same code and data with the former PlanIndex.normalized allocation restored
method.decision_comparison: matched key, mode, line meters and full-profile validity for every row

notes: The initial index load is reported separately and is not included in cross-check timings.
This benchmark does not claim the same reduction for complete validation.
Complete-validation timing is emitted by the application as index_ms, cross_ms, sqlite_lock_wait_ms, pg_store_ms and total_ms and must be sampled after the Windows release.
